name: shuidi-discovery
description: Batch-filter target companies by region, industry, scale, risk, qualifications and business performance. Supports multi-dimensional screening on business registration, judicial risk, honors, bidding, equity relations, etc. One-click removal of dishonest/executed/administrative-penalty entities, and穿透 mining of affiliated enterprise groups from known companies. Ideal for lead generation, supplier admission screening, risk investigation and regional industry analysis.

display.name: 水滴信用-企业发现
display.description_zh: 基于企业数据仓库，面向企业发现与筛选场景：支持按工商信息、司法风险、荣誉资质、招投标、股权关系等多维条件组合筛选企业清单，可一键剔除失信/被执行/行政处罚等风险主体，也可从已知企业出发穿透挖掘关联企业群。适用于获客名单挖掘、供应商准入筛选、风险排查、区域产业分析等场景。
